title: Funding & Awards
policyBody:
Before applications open for any voucher, registration, membership, travel assistance or award, GSSA publishes the eligibility requirements, the quantity available, the application method and deadline, the decision timeline, and the selection criteria.

Applicants may not help develop criteria, review applications, score applicants or approve a selection. Every selection is made by at least three non-applicant reviewers. Executive Board service creates no priority — an officer may apply only with complete recusal.
awardsEmpty: No GSSA opportunities are open right now. Watch this page and our announcements — new opportunities are posted here first.
recipientsNote: Students who have received GSSA-administered opportunities.
externalHeading: Other funding you are eligible for
externalNote: GSSA members are graduate and undergraduate students at SLU, so these university-wide sources are open to you as well.

external.title: GSA Professional Development Awards
external.description: Up to $150 toward attending a conference, or up to $550 toward presenting at one, capped at $550 per student per academic year. Open to most graduate programs.

external.title: GSA Publication Assistance Awards
external.description: Covers 50% of eligible publication costs, up to $500. Apply within 30 days after the expense is paid.

external.title: Brennan Summer Fellowship Awards
external.description: Up to $500 for exam preparation, or up to $1,000 toward a master's thesis or doctoral dissertation. A limited number are awarded each year.

external.title: Graduate Research Symposium
external.description: SLU's annual interdisciplinary showcase each spring, with paper and poster categories judged by faculty and prizes for the top three in each. Geospatial research fits the sciences tracks.
